messages:
Sam: Quick heads-up 1 AcmeLogix asked for a 1-day POC next Fri. Requirements: streaming generation with resumable client reconnect, a tool-call to their shipment API, strict structured JSON output for downstream ETL, and proof of BYOK/KMS + mTLS. Can SE confirm viability and a hosted vs dedicated cost delta?
Priya: Feasible. SDKs support streaming + resume and tool events. For strict JSON recommend function-call schema or `response_mode: json` plus a validation shim in the app. BYOK requires Private deployment. Hosted uses our KMS (per-tenant).
Tomas: mTLS: ops can enable on the demo gateway but needs a 30-60min provisioning window and the client cert bundle. Tool webhooks: runtime needs reachable endpoints. Options: 1) customer exposes a public endpoint, 2) we deliver results in-stream, or 3) we can provision a temporary relay tunnel for the POC (relay requires whitelist + single IP).
Priya: Resume snippet (JS):
```js
// reopen with last resume token
fetch(streamUrl, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${TK}`, 'x-resume-token': lastToken } })
  .then(handleStreamChunk)
```
Also recommend client attach sequence ids to events if ordering matters.
Maya: Trust notes: SOC2 summary is available; full pack via trust@redwood.ai. DPA and EU residency supported (eu-west-1). BYOK -> legal + infra lead time.
Sam: Ballpark demo numbers: assume 30 QPS peak, ~100 tokens avg, 4h demo -> ~43.2M tokens. Hosted = easiest for short run, estimate ~$80200 depending on model. Dedicated cheaper at scale but needs monthly commit and sales signoff.
Priya: Potential blockers to call out in SOW: mTLS provisioning window, webhook reachability/firewall rules, BYOK -> Private + longer lead time (~4-6 weeks), and strict-JSON parsing errors (add validation).
Action items:
- Priya -> one-pager cost compare hosted vs dedicated + recommended model choices (ETA: EOD)
- Tomas -> ops slot request + relay instructions if customer needs tunnel (ETA: tomorrow AM)
- Maya -> SOC2 summary + cert-rotation template (ETA: EOD)
- Sam -> confirm POC date and send client certs/network contact (ETA: EOD)
ops-bot: [info] tentative capacity reserve requested for 2026-09-10 14:00 UTC for "acmelogix-poc".
Sam: Thanks team 1 I'll loop in Acme and flag the blockers in the SOW. :thumbsup:
